title: Rabbah bar Ofran

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Megillah 10b (Hyman cites 10a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.10b.29), where he introduces his exposition of the Megillah with a text from this passage. [Tosafot](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosafot_on_Megillah.10b.29.1) explains that the reading is Ofran, not Efron.
There, [15b (Hyman cites 15a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.15b.10): Rabbah bar Ofran said in the name of Rabbi Elazar, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The first passage has Rabbah bar Ofran introduce his exposition with Jeremiah 49:38. Tosafot explicitly prefers Ofran to Efron.
The second passage gives Rabbah bar Ofran transmitting a teaching in Rabbi Elazar’s name. It continues with two unnamed teachers in succession. Hyman abbreviates the quotation.
